load_cartpole_env: load a cartpole environment with scaled rewards using a given reward_scale and seed
run_cartpole_experiment: run a cartpole scale experiment by calling load with a reward_scale and seed value
review_load_function: review the load function that wraps cartpole with RewardScale and sets episode count
summarize_cartpole_scale: summarize the cartpole_scale module which provides scaled reward cartpole environments
test_load_with_seeds: test the load function with different reward_scale and seed combinations for reproducibility
